parameters.name: AutoPay
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

- **false** (default): disables automatic payment. After an order is generated, you must go to the <props="china">[Order Hub](https://usercenter2.aliyun.com/order/list)</props><props="intl">[Order Hub](https://usercenter2-intl.aliyun.com/order/list)</props> to complete the payment.

- **true**: enables automatic payment. The system automatically pays the bill.

> This parameter is required only for upgrade orders.

parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use coupons. Valid values:

- **true**: yes.

- **false** (default): no.

parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description:
The bandwidth of the bandwidth plan. Unit: Mbit/s.

Valid values: **2** to **2000**.

parameters.name: BandwidthPackageId
parameters.description: The ID of the bandwidth plan that you want to modify.

parameters.name: BandwidthType
parameters.description:
The bandwidth type. Valid values:

- **Basic**: standard bandwidth.

- **Enhanced**: enhanced bandwidth.

- **Advanced**: premium bandwidth.

> You can upgrade a Basic bandwidth plan to Enhanced, or downgrade an **Enhanced** bandwidth plan to **Basic**. You cannot change the bandwidth type of an **Advanced** bandwidth plan.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the bandwidth plan.

The description can be up to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the bandwidth plan.
The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.
